thread:
sam: Quick sync: Launch Pulse next week. idea: 3-arm microtest to see what actually drives activation — credits-only, credits + prompt-kits, credits + prompt-kits + short nudge drip. target metric = 7-day active workspaces.

izzy: agree. keep it tight: 600 signups total (200 per arm). region: NA/EU only. exclude orgs tagged `internal`.

trent: campaign ops note: need creative (hero + 2 social cards) by Tue, cohort seeded Wed AM. i'll set experiment_id=pulse_launch_v1 and push to Growth console.

claire: webinar plan: 20m micro-demo + 10m templates walkthrough. collect `team_size` and `use_case` on signup. offer replay gated by claiming credits for one variant.

sam: nudge cadence proposal: Day0 email w/ promptkit, Day1 in-app quickstart tooltip, Day3 contextual tip; Day7 reward message with extra 75 credits if 3 runs completed. opt-out available.

izzy: measurement: primary=7d_active_pct, secondary=median_time_to_first_success_hours, events=[credit.grant, credit.redeem, prompt.install, quickstart.success]. also add UTM matrix for posts.

trent: launch-bot can you schedule socials Thu 11am PT and replay post Fri 2pm?

launch-bot: scheduled posts: "Pulse: faster builds with prompt kits + starter credits" for 2025-07-10T18:00:00Z and replay for 2025-07-11T19:00:00Z. :white_check_mark:

claire: routing: tag signups `pulse_launch_v1`; route high-intent (>8 seats) to sales, otherwise into nurture. also flag support on credit redemptions >150/hr.

sam: quick creative lines: A) "Ship features faster with prompt kits" B) "Starter credits + templates = faster demos". prefer A for hero.

izzy: ok next steps: trent -> cohort + Growth push Wed AM, claire -> webinar + routing, sam -> creative brief. sync Tue 10am PT after creative drop. thanks team! :rocket:
